name: AI-Authored Semantic Scene Protocol & Offline Integration
research_question: Can strict model-facing JSON DATA, not host-written Python or hidden branching, express two structurally different lessons and deterministically generate native voice-over videos through host validators and Manim?
source_protocols: V3-41 portable strict schema allowlist, required field sets, schema budget and no auto repairs
V3-44 typed partition/ratio proof event graph and Manim compiler, plus exact-frame mux
V3-36 source-model rejection for offline host fixtures
existing static Visual Director research reviewed, no new orchestration service

frozen_topics.shape: two partitions, factor relation, graphic morph, equation

frozen_topics.concept: a deterministic three-step process Start → Verify → Finish
frozen_topics.shape: process nodes, directed edges, sequential traversal events

design_requirements: one single versioned model-facing JSON Schema strict provider portable subset
actual Pydantic semantic validation after JSON schema, never trust schema alone
host-only compiler switches solely on declared validated family, no topic string substring heuristics or special hardcoding for topic ids
no generated executable Python permitted; host alone compiles bounded Manim commands
facts vetted via per-fixture trusted claim registry; narration cannot establish scientific correctness by itself
model-authored provenance only when independently attested real provider receipt; fixture always synthetic
reject invalid graph identities, event order, unsupported transition family, times, layout, visual proof, aspect, claims, illicit numbers, unknown fields and protocol fallback
preregister before code, zero new model HTTP POST or authenticated GET

acceptance.scene_generation: synthetic mock provider JSON only, never counted as genuine AI output
acceptance.video: each 1280x720 H264/AAC 15fps, exact audio-derived frame count, >=4 speaking beats, decoded nonblank and dynamic frames, measured nonzero AAC
semantic: fractions exact rational identity, source target visible & equal whole, label visibly shows numerator and denominator factor
process edges declared directed, no cycles, node state and event traversal ordered along edges
all events within authored beat and claim grounded
acceptance.provider_schema: V3-41 allowlist, <1000 enum values; no refs/anyOf/minItems/unsupported keywords; full required fields and extraProperties=false
nonclaims: no actual model has yet generated a V3-45 JSON scene
not generalization to all 6 curriculum domains
not pedagogical quality or human-blind preference
provider native schema support unverified without paid request
